config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of streets around old residential communities in central Yangzhou (one of four directions at each point), not the paper's images. Residents rate each view on the six emotional perceptions used by Xu & Fan (2025, ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information), the Place Pulse 2.0 dimensions safe, lively, beautiful, wealthy, depressing and boring, on the paper's 0–9 levels. In the paper 126 residents each rated 8–10 images to check model-predicted scores (each image rated by 4–5 people). Differences from the original study: (1) the paper's questionnaire scale is not given; the 0–9 levels of its model scores are used; (2) residence duration and education are recorded as in the paper's sample description.

paper.title: Street View Image-Based Emotional Perception Modeling of Old Residential Communities: An Explainable Framework Integrating Random Forest and SHAP
